text.name: tc_toolTip_lateInvoices
text.text: On: completed jobs are invoiced and paid up to three months later, some late and a few never. Off: jobs pay in full on completion. Invoices already sent still run their course.

text.name: tc_toolTip_randomEvents
text.text: How often rare events, such as a vehicle being stolen, happen to your business. Rare halves the odds, Off stops new ones. Anything already under way still runs its course.

text.name: tc_toolTip_nameStyle
text.text: Where the names of new job candidates and office administrators come from. European mix and Mixed pick a different style for each person. Staff you already have keep their names.

text.name: tc_toolTip_showParkingSlots
text.text: Show your parking slots' markings outside the construction menu too. Just for you: other players choose their own. Right Ctrl+P switches it by default.

text.name: tc_toolTip_jobPayRate
text.text: Scales what new contract offers pay. 100% is half of base-game contract pay. Jobs already offered or accepted keep their price. Business costs (insurance, memberships, training, claims and fines) scale with it; staff pay doesn't.

text.name: tc_inbox_crewHaul
text.text: 2 workers (one harvesting, one hauling), or harvest and haul it all yourself

text.name: tc_inbox_crewPlayerOnly
text.text: Yourself only - workers can't do this job

text.name: tc_inbox_suppliesNeeded
text.text: Needs %s - the job waits until you have some

text.name: tc_equipment_need_cutterMismatch
text.text: Header for %s that fits the harvester

text.name: tc_equipment_need_seedTank
text.text: Seed tank (the seeder has no hopper of its own)

text.name: tc_equipment_need_seedTankHitch
text.text: Seed tank that fits the tractor

text.name: tc_equipment_need_trailerHitch
text.text: Trailer that hitches to the haulage tractor

text.name: tc_equipment_need_implement_fertilize
text.text: Fertilizer spreader, sprayer or manure spreader

text.name: tc_equipment_need_baleTransport
text.text: Whatever you move bales with (bale loader, trailer, front loader)

text.name: tc_equipment_need_disposalSkip
text.text: A disposal skip to carry the pieces to (Contractor tab of the construction menu)

text.name: tc_placeholder_locked
text.text: You haven't started a contracting company on this farm yet. Head to the Overview tab to create one.

text.name: tc_overview_noCompany
text.text: You haven't started a contracting company on this farm yet. Use the button below to create one.

text.name: tc_overview_currentJobsEmpty
text.text: No jobs currently allocated or in progress.

text.name: tc_overview_courtesyDueSuffix
text.text: - courtesy %s goes back to the insurer after this job

text.name: tc_actions_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford to start a company right now.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeIntro
text.text: %s is open for business! Here's how to get things off the ground.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeTip_staff
text.text: Start by looking through the candidates on the Staff tab and hiring a few workers.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeTip_supplies
text.text: Jobs draw their seed, fertiliser, herbicide and diesel from your own stock, so it pays to plan your supplies ahead; the Supplies tab shows what you have.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeTip_overheads
text.text: Before taking on work, check Finances -> Overheads to make sure you're insured and have the cover you need.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeTip_advertising
text.text: Then take out some advertising from the Overview tab to get your name known.

text.name: tc_actions_welcomeTip_jobs
text.text: Job offers will arrive in your Inbox, and more will follow as your reputation grows.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_effect
text.text: At your reputation, adverts work at %d%% of their full effect.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_extends
text.text: Extends your current campaign from %d to %d days left.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_replaces
text.text: Replaces your %s campaign (%d days left). Runs for %d days.

text.name: tc_inbox_empty
text.text: Nothing in your inbox right now — check back later, or buy some advertising to bring more in.

text.name: tc_inbox_counterPrompt
text.text: They offered %s. Enter your counter price:

text.name: tc_inbox_counterInvalid
text.text: Enter a valid price to counter with.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationDeclined
text.text: They've walked away from the negotiation.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationCountered
text.text: They won't do %s, but they'll do %s.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationHolding
text.text: They won't go any higher than %s.

text.name: tc_inbox_jobRejectedInfo
text.text: Negotiation failed: they walked away from %s on Field %s.

text.name: tc_calendar_completedReport
text.text: Done by: %s. %s. Time taken %s. Fuel %s (%.0f l). Quality %s, stuck resets %d.

text.name: tc_unallocate_confirmPlayer
text.text: Take %s off this job? It goes back to Not yet allocated, ready for whoever you allocate next. Any work already done on the field stays done.

text.name: tc_unallocate_confirmYard
text.text: Take %s off this job? They haven't left the yard yet, so they're free straight away. Whoever you allocate next will have to travel out to the field.

text.name: tc_unallocate_confirmOut
text.text: Take %s off this job? They're already out, so their equipment has to come back to the yard, and whoever you allocate next will have to travel out to the field.

text.name: tc_unallocate_confirmWorking
text.text: Take %s off this job? They've made a start (%d%% done). They and their equipment will be unavailable for about %s while they come back, and whoever you allocate next will have to travel out to the field. The work done so far stays done.

text.name: tc_unallocate_dueToday
text.text: This job is due today: a new crew may not finish it in time.

text.name: tc_unallocate_dueTomorrow
text.text: This job is due tomorrow: a new crew may not finish it in time.

text.name: tc_unallocate_problemState
text.text: Only an allocated or in-progress job can be unallocated.

text.name: tc_job_missedNotification
text.text: Missed deadline: %s on Field %s went uncompleted.

text.name: tc_dispatch_noVehicleReady
text.text: None of the allocated equipment can be driven by the worker (is it free, and can it do this job?).

text.name: tc_watchdog_retriedNotification
text.text: Your worker got stuck on a %s job on Field %s - reset and dispatched again.

text.name: tc_watchdog_needsAttentionNotification
text.text: Your worker is stuck on a %s job on Field %s and needs your attention.

text.name: tc_staff_rosterEmpty
text.text: No workers hired yet — switch to the Candidates view to hire your first worker.

text.name: tc_staff_candidatesEmpty
text.text: No candidates currently available to hire — check back later.

text.name: tc_sickness_offSick
text.text: %s has called in sick and can't take jobs for a few days

text.name: tc_sickness_recovered
text.text: %s is back at work after being off sick

text.name: tc_staff_hireConfirm
text.text: Hire %s for %s per month? The salary is charged at the start of every month while they're on your roster. The first month is paid now.

text.name: tc_staff_hireCannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford this candidate's first month of salary right now.

text.name: tc_staff_releaseDriving
text.text: %s is out driving. Stop their vehicle before releasing them.

text.name: tc_drivers_noIdleStaff
text.text: None of your staff are free to drive. Your company's vehicles need a staff driver for AI helpers, AutoDrive, Courseplay and Follow Me.

text.name: tc_drivers_contractorEquipmentDialog
text.text: This vehicle is out on a contract job, so AI helpers, AutoDrive, Courseplay and Follow Me can't drive it.

text.name: tc_drivers_contractorEquipment
text.text: %s is out on a contract job, so AI helpers, AutoDrive, Courseplay and Follow Me can't drive it.

text.name: tc_drivers_stoppedNoDriver
text.text: %s stopped: your company's vehicles need a staff driver. Start it again to pick one.

text.name: tc_drivers_notYourVehicle
text.text: Couldn't assign a driver to %s: it isn't your farm's vehicle.

text.name: tc_drivers_noCompany
text.text: Couldn't assign a driver to %s: you don't have a company.

text.name: tc_drivers_workerUnavailable
text.text: Couldn't assign a driver to %s: that worker isn't free any more.

text.name: tc_vehicleLock_busy
text.text: This vehicle is out on a contract job.

text.name: tc_parkingSlotVehicle_function
text.text: Marks a parking space for vehicles (tractors, loaders, self-propelled machines) coming back from contract jobs, facing the arrow. Implements go in implement parking slots and harvesters in harvester parking slots. Stand in a placed slot to choose what it takes. Only visible in the construction menu, unless you turn on Show parking slots (Right Ctrl+P).

text.name: tc_parkingSlotHarvester_function
text.text: Marks a parking space for a self-propelled harvester (combine, forage or beet harvester) coming back from contract jobs, facing the arrow. Its header goes in an implement parking slot. Stand in a placed slot to choose what it takes. Only visible in the construction menu, unless you turn on Show parking slots (Right Ctrl+P).

text.name: tc_parkingSlotImplement_function
text.text: Marks a parking space for implements and trailers coming back from contract jobs, facing the arrow. Vehicles go in vehicle parking slots. Stand in a placed slot to choose what it takes. Only visible in the construction menu, unless you turn on Show parking slots (Right Ctrl+P).

text.name: tc_parkingSlot_dialogHint_vehicle
text.text: Tick categories or machines to keep this slot for them. They'll come here first, and go to an unfiltered vehicle slot if it's full. Tick nothing to take any vehicle.

text.name: tc_parkingSlot_dialogHint_implement
text.text: Tick categories or machines to keep this slot for them. They'll come here first, and go to an unfiltered implement slot if it's full. Tick nothing to take any implement.

text.name: tc_parkingSlot_dialogHint_harvester
text.text: Tick categories or machines to keep this slot for them. They'll come here first, and go to an unfiltered harvester slot if it's full. Tick nothing to take any harvester.

text.name: tc_parkingSlot_nothingToPick
text.text: Your farm has nothing that parks in this kind of slot yet.

text.name: tc_standingSpot_function
text.text: Somewhere for one of your staff to stand while they've nothing on, facing the arrow. Only visible in the construction menu.

text.name: tc_disposalSkip_function
text.text: Where fly-tipped junk from a clearing job goes. Drop each piece in or right next to it and it's taken away. Every piece from a job costs a small tipping fee.

text.name: tc_logoSign_function
text.text: A freestanding sign showing your company logo, or in single-player a design of your own. Put your square logo.dds in modSettings/FS25_TheContractor, and designs as square .dds images in its signs folder (see the README there). Reload the save to pick new designs.

text.name: tc_wallSign_function
text.text: A flat sign for a wall (1.5 m square, or 3 m for the large one), its bottom edge at the height shown, with your company logo or (single-player) one of your own designs, like the Company Sign. Place it from just in front of the wall; free mode helps against a building.

text.name: tc_parking_messageBody
text.text: These machines are back from a job, but none of your parking slots of the right kind has room for them: %s. They'll be parked as soon as a slot is free. Harvesters go in harvester parking slots, other vehicles in vehicle parking slots, implements and trailers in implement parking slots. Place more from the construction menu, clear the ones you have, or send them to the shop.

text.name: tc_parking_waitingNotification
text.text: No free parking space for %s. Place a vehicle, implement or harvester parking slot to suit, or clear one.

text.name: tc_parking_shopFullNotification
text.text: No room at the shop for %s. Still waiting for a parking space.

text.name: tc_parking_allocationRefusedNotification
text.text: Couldn't allocate: %s is waiting for a parking space and there's no room at the shop to put it.

text.name: tc_parking_noticeOne
text.text: 1 machine waiting for a free parking space

text.name: tc_parking_noticeMany
text.text: %d machines waiting for a free parking space

text.name: tc_dispatch_noAttachPoint
text.text: Couldn't hitch %s to %s - no compatible free attachment point.

text.name: tc_allocation_needsSecondWorker
text.text: Harvest & haul needs two workers - one harvesting, one hauling. Or pick Myself on your own to harvest and haul it all yourself.

text.name: tc_allocation_tooManyWorkers
text.text: This job only takes one worker.

text.name: tc_allocation_haulYourself
text.text: You will harvest the crop and haul it yourself - deliver it to %s.

text.name: tc_allocation_baleAndDeliverYourself
text.text: You will bale the straw and deliver the bales yourself - take them to %s.

text.name: tc_allocation_deliverStrawYourself
text.text: Collect the straw bales from the field and deliver them to %s.

text.name: tc_allocation_playerOnly
text.text: Workers can't do this job - only you can. Select Myself.

text.name: tc_allocation_noSuppliesWarning
text.text: You have no %s in stock - the job will be on hold until you do.

text.name: tc_allocation_busyWarning
text.text: Can't allocate - busy on another job or in cooldown: %s.

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_cutter
text.text: a header or harvester that can harvest %s

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_cutterMismatch
text.text: a header for %s that fits the harvester

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_trailerHitch
text.text: a trailer that hitches to the haulage tractor

text.name: tc_haulage_deliveryComplete
text.text: Delivery done for %s - any more crop you deliver sells as normal.

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_implement_fertilize
text.text: a fertilizer spreader, sprayer or manure spreader

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_seedTank
text.text: a seed tank (front hopper) - the seeder has no hopper of its own

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_seedTankHitch
text.text: a seed tank that fits the tractor (a front hopper needs front linkage)

text.name: tc_supplies_noticeOne
text.text: Out of %s: a job is on hold until you restock.

text.name: tc_supplies_noticeMany
text.text: Out of %s: %d jobs are on hold until you restock.

text.name: tc_allocation_notCertifiedWarning
text.text: %s doesn't hold a %s certificate. Book them on a course from the Staff tab.

text.name: tc_allocation_filledHarvesterWarning
text.text: %s still has %s in its tank. Empty it before it goes out on a job.

text.name: tc_allocation_crewRolesPrompt
text.text: Choose who harvests and who hauls. The recommended way round suits their skills best, but you can swap them round to give the other one the practice.

text.name: tc_allocation_crewRolesQualified
text.text: Both are qualified for their part.

text.name: tc_allocation_underqualifiedWarning
text.text: %s is under-qualified: %s %d, the job needs %d - expect a reduced reward and extra wear on the machines.

text.name: tc_retirement_announced
text.text: %s has handed in their notice and will retire at the start of %s

text.name: tc_retirement_retired
text.text: %s has retired and left your roster

text.name: tc_holiday_cancelled
text.text: %s's holiday was cancelled because the days per month setting changed. They'll book another.

text.name: tc_holiday_requestWithdrawn
text.text: %s has withdrawn their holiday request because the days per month setting changed. They'll ask again.

text.name: tc_holidayRequest_body
text.text: %s would like %d day(s) off: %s. Also off then: %s. Approving will please them. Declining will upset them, and leaving it unanswered until it expires will upset them more. Staff can only be refused twice a year; after that they'll book their holiday whatever.

text.name: tc_holidayRequest_warningBody
text.text: %s has had two holiday requests refused this year. They're entitled to their leave, so they'll book their next holiday whatever, without asking.

text.name: tc_holidayRequest_bookedBodyDeclined
text.text: %s has booked %d day(s) off: %s. They've been refused twice this year, so they haven't asked this time.

text.name: tc_holidayRequest_bookedBodyYearEnd
text.text: %s has booked %d day(s) off: %s. The year's nearly over and they still have leave to take, so they haven't asked this time.

text.name: tc_finances_noInvoiceSelected
text.text: Completed jobs are invoiced here until the customer pays.

text.name: tc_finances_forecastNote
text.text: Invoices by due date, overdue ones not counted. Wages and overheads are charged at the start of each month.

text.name: tc_finances_writeOffConfirm
text.text: Write off the invoice for %s (%s)? It will be treated as never paid.

text.name: tc_finances_writtenOffNotice
text.text: Invoice for %s (%s) written off: the customer never paid.

text.name: tc_overhead_employersLiability_desc
text.text: Required by law once you employ anyone. Priced by headcount at each renewal: %s a year plus %s per employee.

text.name: tc_overheads_noteNotNeeded
text.text: Starts by itself once it's required

text.name: tc_overheads_noteEnds
text.text: Cover ends at the start of %s

text.name: tc_overheads_billingDetail_annual
text.text: Annual, paid up front (12% less than monthly)

text.name: tc_overheads_priceQuote
text.text: %s a year paid annually, or %s a month

text.name: tc_overheads_enableConfirm_annual
text.text: Take out %s? %s is charged now for the year.

text.name: tc_overheads_enableConfirm_monthly
text.text: Take out %s? %s is charged now and at the start of every month.

text.name: tc_overheads_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford %s right now: the first payment is %s.

text.name: tc_overheads_cancelConfirm
text.text: Cancel %s? There's no refund: cover carries on until the start of %s, then stops.

text.name: tc_overheads_startedNotice
text.text: %s taken out: the law requires it once you employ staff. %s a year, paid annually.

text.name: tc_overheads_renewalBody
text.text: Your %s renews in %s, Year %d. Next year's price is %s paid annually (12%% less), or %s a month. If you don't reply it renews as it is (%s). You can also cancel it.

text.name: tc_overheads_renewalBodyMandatory
text.text: Your %s renews in %s, Year %d. It's required by law while you employ staff. Next year's price is %s paid annually (12%% less), or %s a month. If you don't reply it renews as it is (%s).

text.name: tc_overheads_renewalBodyLoaded
text.text: Your %s renews in %s, Year %d. Next year's price is %s paid annually (12%% less), or %s a month. That includes a claims loading of +%d%% for %d claim(s) in the last 3 years. If you don't reply it renews as it is (%s). You can also cancel it.

text.name: tc_overhead_publicLiability_desc
text.text: Covers job damage to customers' crops or land, less a %s excess per claim. %s a year plus %s per worker, +35%% per claim in the last 3 years.

text.name: tc_theft_stolenBody
text.text: Your %s has been stolen. It's been reported to the police under crime reference %s. You'll hear back once the police have finished their enquiries.

text.name: tc_theft_stolenNotice
text.text: %s stolen and reported to the police

text.name: tc_theft_recoveredBody
text.text: Good news: the police have found your %s (crime reference %s). It's been knocked about and needs a wash, and it'll be back in your yard as soon as there's a free parking slot.

text.name: tc_theft_lostBody
text.text: The police have closed their enquiries into the theft of your %s (crime reference %s) without finding it. It's gone for good and has been taken off your fleet.

text.name: tc_theft_lostBodyInsured
text.text: The police have closed their enquiries into the theft of your %s (crime reference %s) without finding it. It's gone for good, but it was insured on the day it was taken, so you can claim for it.

text.name: tc_joyriders_ownBody
text.text: Joyriders have been driving round your grass on Field %s and torn it up. It'll need plowing and sowing again.

text.name: tc_joyriders_offerBody
text.text: Joyriders have been driving round the grass on Field %s and torn it up. The farmer wants it plowed so it can be sown again, and has offered you the job.

text.name: tc_dieselTheft_tankBody
text.text: Thieves got into the yard overnight and drained the diesel tank: about %s gone. It's been reported to the police, but there's little chance of seeing it again. Jobs needing diesel will wait if there isn't enough left.

text.name: tc_dieselTheft_siphonBody
text.text: Thieves got into the yard overnight and siphoned the diesel out of %s of your parked machines: about %s gone. It's been reported to the police, but there's little chance of seeing it again.

text.name: tc_goodNews_photoPosted_body
text.text: Someone has posted a photo of your work in the local farming group, and the comments are full of praise. You gained %s reputation.

text.name: tc_goodNews_parishNews_body
text.text: Your business gets a write-up in the parish newsletter as local business of the month. You gained %s reputation.

text.name: tc_goodNews_parishCouncil_body
text.text: The parish council has written to thank you for keeping the lanes clean after your machines have been through. You gained %s reputation.

text.name: tc_goodNews_youngFarmers_title
text.text: A word from the Young Farmers

text.name: tc_goodNews_youngFarmers_body
text.text: The local Young Farmers' club has named you as an example of a highly professional contractor in their newsletter. You gained %s reputation.

text.name: tc_goodNews_supplierRefund_body
text.text: One of your suppliers has spotted that they overcharged you on an earlier bill, and has refunded the difference: %s.

text.name: tc_goodNews_loyaltyRebate_title
text.text: A good word from the supplier

text.name: tc_goodNews_loyaltyRebate_body
text.text: Your regular supplier is grateful for your custom and has sent you a loyalty rebate: %s.

text.name: tc_goodNews_ratesRefund_body
text.text: The council has recalculated your business rates and found you've been paying too much. They've refunded the overpayment: %s.

text.name: tc_jobNews_kettle_eventName
text.text: The customer puts the kettle on

text.name: tc_jobNews_kettle_title
text.text: The customer put the kettle on

text.name: tc_jobNews_kettle_bodyOne
text.text: As %s was finishing up on Field %s, the farmer came out with tea and bacon butties. They're in better spirits for it.

text.name: tc_jobNews_kettle_bodyTwo
text.text: As %s and %s were finishing up on Field %s, the farmer came out with tea and bacon butties. They're both in better spirits for it.

text.name: tc_jobNews_paidEarly_body
text.text: The farmer on Field %s is so pleased with the work that they've paid your invoice straight away: %s.

text.name: tc_jobNews_stepsUp_body
text.text: Something finally clicked for %s on Field %s. Their %s is up to %s, and they're feeling more confident.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_rearEnded_atFaultBody
text.text: On the way back from Field %s, %s turned off the road without signalling and a car ran into the back of the %s. The police have put it down to our driver, so expect a claim from the other driver in the next few days. Your driver is shaken up, and word gets around: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_rearEnded_notAtFaultBody
text.text: On the way back from Field %s, %s was hit from behind by a car that didn't stop in time, and the %s is damaged. It wasn't our driver's fault: the other driver's insurer will be in touch about the repair.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_clipped_atFaultBody
text.text: On the way back from Field %s, %s took a bend too wide and a car coming the other way clipped the %s. The police have put it down to our driver, so expect a claim from the other driver in the next few days. Your driver is shaken up, and word gets around: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_clipped_notAtFaultBody
text.text: On the way back from Field %s, %s was overtaken on a bend by a car that cut in too soon and clipped the %s. It wasn't our driver's fault: the other driver's insurer will be in touch about the repair.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_notice
text.text: Road accident on the way back from Field %s: the %s is damaged

text.name: tc_roadAccident_claimBodyInsured
text.text: The other driver in the accident on the way back from Field %s (%s was driving for you) is claiming %s for their car and their injuries. Your public liability insurance covers it, less the excess: %s has been charged. The claim goes on your record and will raise your premium for the next 3 years.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_claimBodyUninsured
text.text: The other driver in the accident on the way back from Field %s (%s was driving for you) is claiming %s for their car and their injuries. You don't have public liability insurance, so the whole %s has been charged.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_assessedBody
text.text: The other driver's insurer has accepted the blame for the accident with your %s and estimates the repair at %s. They'll pay it, but don't expect it quickly.

text.name: tc_roadAccident_paymentNotice
text.text: %s due from the other driver's insurer for the %s

text.name: tc_roadAccident_paidBody
text.text: The other driver's insurer has finally paid for the repair to your %s: %s.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_neighbour_complaintBody
text.text: A neighbour of Field %s says the herbicide %s put on it drifted over the hedge and scorched their garden and paddock. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_neighbour_complaintBodyField
text.text: A neighbour of Field %s says the herbicide %s put on it drifted over the hedge and scorched their garden and paddock, by Field %s. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_beekeeper_complaintBody
text.text: A beekeeper with hives next to Field %s says the herbicide %s put on it drifted onto them while the bees were out foraging, and they've lost colonies. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_beekeeper_complaintBodyField
text.text: A beekeeper with hives next to Field %s says the herbicide %s put on it drifted onto them, on Field %s, while the bees were out foraging, and they've lost colonies. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_organicGrower_complaintBody
text.text: An organic grower next to Field %s says the herbicide %s put on it drifted onto their crop, which could cost it its organic status. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_organicGrower_complaintBodyField
text.text: An organic grower says the herbicide put on Field %s by %s drifted onto their crop on Field %s, which could cost it its organic status. We're looking into it: expect the findings in a week or two.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_notice
text.text: Spray drift complaint about Field %s: being looked into

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_clearedBodyCalm
text.text: The complaint about spraying on Field %s has been dropped. %s's spray records and certificate were in order, and it was a calm day: whatever they found, it wasn't from us.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_clearedBodyBreezy
text.text: The complaint about spraying on Field %s has been dropped. %s's spray records and certificate were in order, and the wind on the day was within limits for the nozzles used: whatever they found, it wasn't from us.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_damage_organicGrower
text.text: the crop that lost its organic status

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_upheldBodyInsured
text.text: The complaint about spraying on Field %s has been upheld: %s carried on spraying when the conditions said stop, and it drifted. They're claiming %s for %s. Your public liability insurance covers it, less the excess: %s has been charged. The claim goes on your record and will raise your premium for the next 3 years, and word has got around: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_upheldBodyUninsured
text.text: The complaint about spraying on Field %s has been upheld: %s carried on spraying when the conditions said stop, and it drifted. They're claiming %s for %s. You don't have public liability insurance, so the whole %s has been charged, and word has got around: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_sprayDrift_upheldNotice
text.text: Spray drift complaint about Field %s upheld: %s paid

text.name: tc_poaching_offerBody
text.text: %s has been approached by %s, who want them for the coming harvest and have offered %s a month. They're paid %s now, and their morale is %s. You can match the offer, or do nothing and leave it to them. If you do nothing they'll most likely take the offer and hand in a month's notice, though a happy, well-paid worker might stay. A matched offer is a permanent rise from the next salary run.

text.name: tc_poaching_matchConfirm
text.text: Raise %s's pay to %s a month to match the offer? A rise is permanent and starts from the next salary run.

text.name: tc_poaching_stayedBody
text.text: %s has turned down the offer from %s and is staying with you, on the same pay.

text.name: tc_poaching_leftBody
text.text: %s has accepted the offer from %s and handed in their notice. They leave at the start of %s.

text.name: tc_joyriders_sowBody
text.text: The farmer was pleased with the plowing on Field %s and has offered you the job of sowing it back to grass.

text.name: tc_flyTipping_offerBody
text.text: Someone has dumped a load of junk just inside the gate of Field %s, %s pieces in all. The farmer wants it cleared and has offered you the job. Carry each piece to a disposal skip (from the Contractor tab of the construction menu) and drop it there.

text.name: tc_overheads_priceFrom
text.text: From %s a year paid annually, or %s a month

text.name: tc_overheads_levelPrompt
text.text: Choose the level of cover for %s.

text.name: tc_overheads_levelChangePrompt
text.text: Choose the level of cover for %s from its renewal. You're on %s cover now.

text.name: tc_overhead_machineryInsurance_desc
text.text: Covers your machinery against theft. Basic pays 80%% of a lost vehicle's value less a %s excess, Standard pays 90%% of it less %s, Comprehensive its full value less %s and lends you a similar tractor while the claim settles. Priced at 1%%, 1.4%% or 1.8%% of your fleet's value a year, +35%% per claim in the last 3 years.

text.name: tc_insurance_levelDescription
text.text: Pays %d%% of a lost vehicle's value, less a %s excess.

text.name: tc_insurance_levelDescriptionCourtesy
text.text: Pays %d%% of a lost vehicle's value, less a %s excess, and lends you a courtesy vehicle until the claim settles.

text.name: tc_insurance_claimBody
text.text: Your %s is insured (%s cover), so you can claim for it. Once the claim's in, the insurer takes 1-2 months to settle. If you don't submit it within the month, it goes in anyway. An office administrator would have sent it straight off and had it settled sooner.

text.name: tc_insurance_claimByAdminBody
text.text: Your administrator has submitted the insurance claim for your %s (%s cover). The insurer should settle it within the month.

text.name: tc_insurance_submitConfirm
text.text: Submit the insurance claim for your stolen %s? The insurer takes 1-2 months to settle it.

text.name: tc_insurance_claimNotice
text.text: Insurance claim in for the stolen %s: waiting for the insurer to settle

text.name: tc_insurance_settledBody
text.text: Your insurer has settled the claim for your stolen %s, valued at %s. %s cover pays %d%% of that, less the %s excess: %s has been paid to you. The claim goes on your record and will raise your premium for the next 3 years.

text.name: tc_courtesy_lentBody
text.text: Your comprehensive cover includes a courtesy vehicle, so your insurer has lent you a %s in place of your stolen %s. It's at %s. Use it as your own, jobs included: it can't be sold, and it costs nothing to run beyond its fuel. The insurer takes it back when the claim settles.

text.name: tc_courtesy_lentNotice
text.text: Courtesy %s lent by your insurer, at %s

text.name: tc_courtesy_dueBody
text.text: Your claim has settled, so your insurer wants the courtesy %s back. It's busy right now, so they'll collect it as soon as it's free: if it's out on a job, when the job's equipment comes home.

text.name: tc_courtesy_returnedBody
text.text: Your insurer has collected the courtesy %s now that your claim has settled.

text.name: tc_claims_bodyInsured
text.text: The owner of field %d says %s %s during the %s job, and is claiming %s for the damage. Your public liability insurance covers it, less the excess: %s has been charged. The claim goes on your record and will raise your premium for the next 3 years. Word gets around, too: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_claims_bodyUninsured
text.text: The owner of field %d says %s %s during the %s job, and is claiming %s for the damage. You don't have public liability insurance, so the whole %s has been charged. Word gets around, too: your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_claims_noticeInsured
text.text: Compensation claim on field %d: %s excess paid by you, the rest by your insurer.

text.name: tc_claims_noticeUninsured
text.text: Compensation claim on field %d: %s paid in full, uninsured.

text.name: tc_claims_cause_ruts
text.text: left deep ruts across the field

text.name: tc_claims_cause_compaction
text.text: worked the field too wet and compacted the soil

text.name: tc_claims_cause_boundary
text.text: damaged the hedge and fence along the boundary

text.name: tc_claims_cause_scorch
text.text: overlapped the passes and scorched the crop

text.name: tc_claims_cause_drift
text.text: let the spray drift onto the neighbouring crop

text.name: tc_claims_cause_cropDamage
text.text: went too close and tore out part of the crop

text.name: tc_claims_cause_roadAccident
text.text: caused a road accident on the way back

text.name: tc_claims_cause_sprayDrift
text.text: let the spray drift onto a neighbour's land

text.name: tc_overhead_tradeAssociation_desc
text.text: Trade association membership, %s a year. Members earn 5%% more reputation per job, get 25%% off certification courses and cheaper legal cover.

text.name: tc_overhead_legalExpenses_desc
text.text: Pursue overdue invoices free, with better odds of recovery. %s a year, or %s for association members (from the next renewal).

text.name: tc_legal_pursueConfirmCovered
text.text: Pursue the invoice for %s (%s)? Your legal cover handles it at no cost. Expect an outcome in 1-2 months.

text.name: tc_legal_pursueConfirmSolicitor
text.text: Instruct a solicitor to recover the invoice for %s (%s)? Their fee and the court fee come to %s, paid now and not refunded if it fails. Expect an outcome in 1-2 months.

text.name: tc_legal_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford a solicitor right now: the fee is %s. Legal expenses insurance would cover it.

text.name: tc_legal_recoveredBody
text.text: The customer for the %s job on field %s has paid the overdue invoice in full: %s.

text.name: tc_legal_failedBodyCovered
text.text: Your legal cover couldn't recover the money for the %s job on field %s. The customer can't pay, so the %s invoice has been written off.

text.name: tc_legal_failedBodySolicitor
text.text: Your solicitor couldn't recover the money for the %s job on field %s. The customer can't pay, so the %s invoice has been written off, and the %s fee isn't refunded.

text.name: tc_legal_failedNotice
text.text: Pursuit failed: the invoice for %s (%s) has been written off.

text.name: tc_overhead_healthSafety_desc
text.text: PPE, first aid, training and risk assessments: %s per worker a year. Staff get sick less and recover sooner. Without it, sickness risks an inspection and a fine.

text.name: tc_admin_billing
text.text: Monthly salary, paid with the salary run

text.name: tc_admin_desc
text.text: Handles invoicing and credit control: customers pay sooner, and fewer pay late or not at all. Only invoices issued while employed.

text.name: tc_admin_hireConfirm
text.text: Hire an office administrator for %s a month? The first month is paid now. Customers will pay sooner, and fewer will pay late or not at all.

text.name: tc_admin_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford an office administrator right now: the first month's salary is %s.

text.name: tc_admin_releaseConfirmNotice
text.text: Release %s, your office administrator? After %d full year(s) of service, you'll pay them %s in lieu of %s week(s)' notice. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_admin_releaseConfirmRedundancy
text.text: Release %s, your office administrator? After %d full years of service, you'll pay them %s: %s in lieu of %s weeks' notice and %s redundancy pay. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_admin_hiredNotification
text.text: %s has started as your office administrator

text.name: tc_healthSafety_inspectionNotice
text.text: Workplace inspection after %s fell sick: no health and safety programme in place. Fined %s, and your reputation has taken a knock.

text.name: tc_training_confirmCourse
text.text: Book %s on a %s course for %s? Training is on %s, with the assessment %d-%d days after. They can't take jobs on those days. If they're out on a job when it's due, it moves back.

text.name: tc_training_confirmRetake
text.text: Book %s a retake of the %s assessment for %s? The assessment is on %s. They can't take jobs that day. If they're out on a job when it's due, it moves back.

text.name: tc_training_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford %s's %s course right now: it costs %s.

text.name: tc_training_cannotAffordNotice
text.text: Couldn't book %s's %s course: you can't afford %s.

text.name: tc_training_booked
text.text: %s is booked on a %s course: training %s, assessment %s

text.name: tc_training_bookedRetake
text.text: %s is booked for a %s assessment retake on %s

text.name: tc_training_courseDone
text.text: %s is back from their %s course. Assessment: %s

text.name: tc_training_passed
text.text: %s passed and now holds a %s certificate

text.name: tc_training_requestBody
text.text: %s would like to take their %s certificate, so they can do herbicide work. The course costs %s, and they'd be away for %d days of training plus an assessment day a few days later.

text.name: tc_training_requestBodyRetake
text.text: %s would like another go at their %s assessment. A retake costs %s and takes one day.

text.name: tc_training_failedBody
text.text: %s didn't pass their %s assessment. They've done the course, so they only need to retake the assessment: one day, costing %s. You can book it now or later from the Staff tab.

text.name: tc_morale_harvestBody
text.text: Harvest is nearly here, and your staff are asking whether there'll be a bonus this year. A small bonus is %s each and a generous one %s each. With %d staff on the roster, that's %s or %s in total. Saying no, or not answering, will go down badly.

text.name: tc_morale_harvestBonusNotice
text.text: Your staff are pleased with their %s harvest bonus

text.name: tc_morale_noHarvestBonusNotice
text.text: Your staff are disappointed there's no harvest bonus this year

text.name: tc_morale_bonusPrompt
text.text: Give %s a one-off bonus? It's paid now, with their wages, and lifts their morale.

text.name: tc_morale_bonusCannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford a %s bonus for %s.

text.name: tc_morale_bonusConfirm
text.text: %s has been paid a %s bonus. It has improved their morale.

text.name: tc_morale_quitNotice
text.text: %s has quit and leaves at the start of %s.

text.name: tc_morale_quitAnnounced
text.text: %s is unhappy and has handed in their notice. They leave at the start of %s

text.name: tc_staff_releaseConfirmNotice
text.text: Release %s from your roster? After %d full year(s) of service, you'll pay them %s in lieu of %s week(s)' notice. The rest of your staff won't like it. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_staff_releaseConfirmRedundancy
text.text: Release %s from your roster? After %d full years of service, you'll pay them %s: %s in lieu of %s weeks' notice and %s redundancy pay. The rest of your staff won't like it. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_staff_releaseConfirmLeaving
text.text: Release %s now? They're already leaving, so you'll only pay %s for the %s week(s)' notice they have left. The rest of your staff won't like it. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_staff_releaseConfirmLeavingNow
text.text: Release %s now? They're leaving as soon as they're back, so there's nothing more to pay. The rest of your staff won't like it. This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_pay_requestBody
text.text: %s would like a pay rise. They're paid %s a month and would like %s, after %d full year(s) with you. You could agree, meet them halfway at %s, or refuse. Refusing, or not answering, will go down badly, and staff paid less than they expect grow unhappy. A rise starts from the next salary run.

text.name: tc_pay_riseNotice
text.text: %s's pay is now %s a month, from the next salary run

text.name: tc_pay_risePromptWants
text.text: Give %s a pay rise? They're paid %s a month and would like %s. A rise is permanent and starts from the next salary run.

text.name: tc_pay_risePrompt
text.text: Give %s a pay rise? They're paid %s a month and are happy with it, but paying more than they expect lifts their morale for a while. A rise is permanent and starts from the next salary run.
